/* SmsXrayManageMapper.getSmsXrayManageList */ SELECT B.ORGN_CD , B.ORGN_NM , A.USER_ID , B.USER_NM , A.TEL_NO , A.SEND_URL , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.USE_START_DATE, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.USE_END_DATE, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS USE_PERIOD , A.USE_START_DATE , A.APPR_FG , A.REG_DT , A.REG_ID , A.MOD_DT , A.MOD_ID , A.APPR_ID , (SELECT USER_NM FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 WHERE USER_ID = A.APPR_ID) AS APPR_NM , A.APPR_REASON FROM TB_CM_SMS_XRAY_WHITE A , TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 B WHERE B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID
AND B.ORGN_CD LIKE '%' ||#{orgnCd}|| '%'
AND B.ORGN_NM LIKE '%' ||#{orgnNm}|| '%'
AND B.USER_ID LIKE '%' ||#{reqId}|| '%'
AND B.USER_NM LIKE '%' ||#{reqNm}|| '%'
AND A.APPR_FG LIKE '%' ||#{apprFg}|| '%'
ORDER BY B.ORGN_CD , A.USER_ID , A.TEL_NO , A.SEND_URL , A.USE_START_DATE
